stagewise_protocol.average_incremental_accuracy: Unweighted mean of stage seen-class balanced accuracies
stagewise_protocol.calibration: Common permanent TRAIN Normal holdout at each stage; Section27.9 Normal-only tau extension for multiclass models; stored strict gate threshold for AA variants
stagewise_protocol.decomposition: For an attack class at its earliest maximum-recall preceding stage: change in unconditional Normal-miss rate plus change in other-attack-family rate equals signed recall loss
stagewise_protocol.forgetting: For each class introduced before the final task: maximum recall over preceding stages minus final recall; unweighted class mean; signed values retained
stagewise_protocol.prior: Original prepared TRAIN class frequencies, including permanently heldout rows; no TEST prior
stagewise_protocol.secondary_old_class_scope: Old attack classes only, excluding Normal
stagewise_protocol.seen_labels: Mask model outputs and TEST rows to the current seen classes
stagewise_protocol.selection: Earliest completed physical source per dataset/method/seed, never by metric

positioning: Required KD comparison fails; retain a trade-off study
limitations: UNSW is exploratory because KD was reconsidered after its formal outcomes were available.
NSL seeds 1/2 were available before the Section29.9 document commit, and all five before direct authorization; no user inspection is inferred.

Partial group means use only completed trajectories at their actual n; a single seed has null sample SD. Partial checkpoints never supply completed-cell metrics.
Known necessary-condition failure takes precedence over other missing evidence; no seed is dropped.
Paired one-sided tests are unadjusted; no detected harm is not equivalence or noninferiority.
Section29.8 CBF failure and the original Section27.8 failure remain unchanged.

wrapper_identity.calibration_prior_role: Original complete prepared TRAIN labels before permanent holdout or smoke subsampling; no TEST role

calibration_protocol.finite_sample_limit: FP <= floor(alpha * calibration_count); strict Normal prior maximum and nonincreasing observed FP required
calibration_protocol.limitation: The permanent pool was available to allocation validation; it is not a fresh independent calibration sample
calibration_protocol.pool: Same seed-specific permanent Normal TRAIN holdout for every method; never optimized
calibration_protocol.replay_la: Same Replay weights and total tau; baseline tau=1 plus delta, no extra training or inference
calibration_protocol.rule: First adjacent initial-grid bracket when present; otherwise expand toward the missing infeasible lower or feasible upper endpoint; retain feasible upper endpoint after 50 bisections
calibration_protocol.test_role: Evaluate selected total tau only; test metrics never select tau or the expansion range

effective_config.deadline_compatibility_note: Frozen Replay-BS API requires a timestamp; far-future sentinel disables the historical owner cutoff only. Slurm walltime/signals/telemetry remain active.
